payload.name: Resize Photo 200x230 by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup 200 x 230 photo resize workflow for upload forms.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based 200 x 230 photo resize helper for exam, job, profile, school, and application upload forms that validate exact pixel dimensions. It opens a local resize workflow, keeps ordinary files on the device, and includes an optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request after a public-safe fit check.
